description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the JobCategoryService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to retrieving job category data, utilizing mock objects and test data fixtures.

classes.name: JobCategoryServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for the JobCategoryService class, testing retrieval of job categories and by ID using mock DAO objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of JobCategoryService and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests the getJobCategoryList() method of JobCategoryService, verifying it returns expected list of job categories.

methods.name: testGtJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests the getJobCategoryById() method, verifying it correctly retrieves a single job category based on ID.
